statement: An established multi-replica partition follower forwards writes to a newly elected peer while its SERVICES cache is lagging; routing uses only a validated live Raft address for the matching partition replica, never a stale bootstrap hint or a second topology authority, and one unchanged fresh MovieLens live run completes ratings split provisioning without peer-address-resolution participant failures and reports priority metric 0.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Do not change the MovieLens 180000ms schema budget, 60000ms stability window, 600000ms ratings-provisioning wait, workload, joins, preload size, ratings-only split policy, report conversion, retry duration, operation deadlines, concurrency budgets, or live scenario semantics.

The SERVICES cache remains canonical and wins when present. During cache lag, only the current Raft leader's already-unified address may bridge routing, and only after its parsed service type and replica identity match the requested partition peer; do not admit bootstrap hints, arbitrary inbound senders, a new cache, or a second topology owner.

A malformed, non-partition, mismatched-replica, or no-longer-current Raft leader address must not become a forwarding target; cache-backed relocation and existing peer reconciliation remain authoritative.

Before changing runtime source, reproduce the exact established-follower path through a real PartitionService leader transition and routed write with the new leader absent from SERVICES and bootstrap peer hints, then prove red-on-revert and cover cache override plus mismatched-live-leader rejection.

The 2026-07-19T08:49:05.180Z unchanged live run is the pre-fix witness: schema admission passed, sql_transactions-p1-r5 became the term-3 leader and active, all three canonical SERVICES replicas retained its unified address, yet established r4 failed to resolve r5 for over nine minutes and the ratings split's sql_transactions UPSERT aborted with DISTRIBUTED_PARTICIPANT_FAILURE.
